exec_tick -> cmd\n\n        self.current_plan: List[str] = []\n        self.last_plan_tick: int = -100\n        self.cached_path_goal: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None\n        self.cached_path: List[Tuple[float, float]] = []\n\n    def solar_charge(self, tick: int) -> float:\n        return self.solar_peak * self.eff_est * math.sin(\n            math.pi * (tick + self.sun_margin) / (self.max_ticks + 2.0 * self.sun_margin)\n        )\n\n    def ingest_packets(self, packets: List[Dict[str, Any]], map_fetcher=None) -> None:\n        discovered_new = False\n        for pkt in packets:\n            tk = int(pkt[\"tick\"])\n            if tk <= self.last_pkt_tick:\n                continue\n\n            # Identify exact solar efficiency from first non-zero charge packet\n            if not self.eff_known and pkt[\"charge\"] > 0.0:\n                denom = self.solar_peak * math.sin(\n                    math.pi * (tk + self.sun_margin) / (self.max_ticks + 2.0 * self.sun_margin)\n                )\n                if denom > 1e-6:\n                    self.eff_est = max(\n                        self.rules[\"solar_efficiency_range\"][0],\n                        min(self.rules[\"solar_efficiency_range\"][1], pkt[\"charge\"] / denom),\n                    )\n                    self.eff_known = True\n\n            cmd = self.sent_cmds.get(tk)\n            # Check for unexpected safety_stop (queue cleared by simulator!)\n            if cmd and cmd.get(\"action\") == \"drive\" and pkt[\"wheel_odometry\"] < cmd[\"metres\"] - 1e-4:\n                # Queue was cleared after tick tk\n                for future_t in list(self.sent_cmds.keys()):\n                    if future_t > tk:\n                        del self.sent_cmds[future_t]\n                self.last_plan_tick = -100  # force replan\n\n            self.ekf.step_and_update(cmd, pkt)\n            self.last_pkt_tick = tk\n            self.last_bat = float(pkt[\"battery\"])\n            self.sampled_ids = set(pkt[\"sampled_targets\"])\n\n            for ev in pkt.get(\"events\", []):\n                ev_str = str(ev)\n                if \"discover\" in ev_str.lower() or (isinstance(ev, dict) and ev.get(\"type\") == \"target_discovered\"):\n                    discovered_new = True\n\n        if discovered_new and map_fetcher is not None:\n            world = map_fetcher()\n            for t in world[\"targets\"]:\n                if t[\"id\"] not in self.target_by_id:\n                    self.targets.append(t)\n                    self.target_by_id[t[\"id\"]] = t\n            self.last_plan_tick = -100  # force immediate replan on discovery\n\n    def predict_state_at(self, target_tick: int) -> Tuple[float, float, float, set]:\n        \"\"\"Forward rollout from last_pkt_tick using EKF state & queued commands.\"\"\"\n        x, y = self.ekf.mu[0], self.ekf.mu[1]\n        bias = self.ekf.mu[2]\n        slip = self.ekf.slip_dict()\n        bat = self.last_bat\n        pending_sampled = set(self.sampled_ids)\n\n        for k in range(self.last_pkt_tick + 1, target_tick):\n            bat = min(self.bat_cap, bat + self.solar_charge(k))\n            bat = max(0.0, bat - self.idle_cost)\n            cmd = self.sent_cmds.get(k)\n            if cmd is None or cmd[\"action\"] == \"wait\":\n                continue\n            elif cmd[\"action\"] == \"sample\":\n                bat = max(0.0, bat - self.sample_cost)\n                # Predict which target would be sampled\n                best_tid, best_d = None, self.target_radius\n                for t in self.targets:\n                    if t[\"id\"] not in pending_sampled:\n                        d = math.hypot(t[\"x\"] - x, t[\"y\"] - y)\n                        if d <= best_d:\n                            best_d = d\n                            best_tid = t[\"id\"]\n                if best_tid is not None:\n                    pending_sampled.add(best_tid)\n            elif cmd[\"action\"] == \"drive\":\n                res = drive(\n                    self.surface, self.physics, x, y,\n                    cmd[\"heading_deg\"] + bias, cmd[\"metres\"], slip, battery=bat\n                )\n                x, y = res[\"x\"], res[\"y\"]\n                bat = max(0.0, bat - res[\"energy\"])\n\n        return x, y, bat, pending_sampled\n\n    def _choose_drive_cmd(\n        self, x: float, y: float, bat: float, wp_x: float, wp_y: float,\n        final_x: float, final_y: float, is_final_goal: bool\n    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        bias = self.ekf.mu[2]\n        slip = self.ekf.slip_dict()\n        dx, dy = wp_x - x, wp_y - y\n        dist_wp = math.hypot(dx, dy)\n        dist_final = math.hypot(final_x - x, final_y - y)\n        desired_deg = math.degrees(math.atan2(dy, dx))\n\n        # Estimate wheel metres needed\n        _, _, _, code = self.surface.sample(x, y)\n        tname = TERRAIN_CODES[code]\n        est_slip = min(0.8, slip[tname])\n        if is_final_goal and dist_final <= self.max_metres * 1.1:\n            # Aim to land squarely on target/base without overshooting\n            M = min(self.max_metres, max(0.25, dist_final / max(0.2, 1.0 - est_slip)))\n        else:\n            M = self.max_metres\n\n        # Check battery safety: leave at least 3.0 battery after this drive\n        # Rough max cost of M metres + climb\n        if bat < 5.0:\n            return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n\n        # Search heading around desired_deg - bias to compensate for bias AND cross-slope side-slip\n        base_H = desired_deg - bias\n        best_H = base_H\n        best_M = M\n        best_score = 1e18\n\n        # Candidate wheel lengths (full M, or shorter if safety requires)\n        m_cands = [M] if M <= 2.5 else [M, max(1.0, M * 0.6), 1.5]\n        for m_try in m_cands:\n            found_safe_for_m = False\n            for off in (0.0, -3.0, 3.0, -6.0, 6.0, -12.0, 12.0, -22.0, 22.0, -35.0, 35.0):","lineStart":685,"lineEnd":904,"totalLines":1035,"truncated":true}},"title":"app/rover_brain.py","time":{"start":1794706267122,"end":1794706267129}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":"ErEBCq4BAWkUfRMlSreOJptyJryRNFLORROdQGQb+sf2tqoLOSW2JL9YKYYciqaDQzAW1/xbvoB5ft3Is7jhEKMxoUISjBCoB1j91ntogE6OB+TaR/gi1BHnq9B1NA9m9y7j/AuHYAwU5Brcb9Gue0D1NaqQlIYGdls0ZG5kMj/otSKfgGNxzVSFP9ljtb1Ab8wmZxAfZO77RRMfJTVh1Q6+NFK0gTJ483q5CV7ManQWGphM"}},"id":"prt_1dcd45bee001O411dyjx4jKEOj","sessionID":"ses_e2332780dffeAsz0uMEMGIoX2Z","messageID":"msg_1dcd453a5001XUDKJDTCaMcjjt"}}

campaign autopilot for Lightlag Traverse (3 missions).\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nimport sys\nimport time\nimport traceback\n\nfrom lightlag_client import RemoteToolError, connect\nfrom rover_brain import RoverMissionAgent\n\n\ndef run_campaign(url: str = \"http://lightlag:8000/mcp\") -> None:\n    t_campaign = time.monotonic()\n    with connect(url) as tools:\n        campaign_complete = False\n        while not campaign_complete:\n            rules = tools.rules()\n            if rules.get(\"campaign\", {}).get(\"complete\"):\n                print(\"Campaign already complete.\", flush=True)\n                break\n\n            world = tools.map()\n            packets = tools.telemetry_log()\n            mission = world[\"mission\"]\n            max_ticks = int(rules[\"max_ticks\"])\n            delay = int(rules[\"delay_ticks\"])\n\n            print(\n                f\"\\n=== Starting Mission {mission}/{world['missions']} | \"\n                f\"base={world['base']} | initial_targets={len(world['targets'])} | \"\n                f\"pkt0_tick={packets[-1]['tick']} ===\",\n                flush=True,\n            )\n\n            agent = RoverMissionAgent(rules, world, packets[:1])\n            if len(packets) > 1:\n                agent.ingest_packets(packets[1:], map_fetcher=tools.map)\n\n            current_tick = int(packets[-1][\"tick\"])\n            last_queued = current_tick\n            t_mission = time.monotonic()\n\n            while current_tick < max_ticks:\n                target_q = min(max_ticks, current_tick + delay + 1)\n                while last_queued < target_q:\n                    et = max(current_tick + delay + 1, last_queued + 1)\n                    if et > max_ticks:\n                        break\n                    cmd = agent.decide_command(current_tick, et)\n                    try:\n                        acks = tools.uplink([cmd])\n                    except RemoteToolError as exc:\n                        print(f\"[M{mission} t={current_tick}] uplink error for et={et}: {exc}\", flush=True)\n                        break\n                    exec_t = int(acks[0][\"execute_tick\"])\n                    agent.sent_cmds[exec_t] = cmd\n                    last_queued = exec_t\n\n                out = tools.advance(1)\n                if out.get(\"episode_complete\"):\n                    # Print end-of-mission summary from any final packets returned\n                    final_pkts = out.get(\"packets\", [])\n                    for p in final_pkts:\n                        if p.get(\"mission\") == mission:\n                            agent.ingest_packets([p])\n                    dist_base = math.hypot(agent.ekf.mu[0] - world[\"base\"][0], agent.ekf.mu[1] - world[\"base\"][1])\n                    dt_m = time.monotonic() - t_mission\n                    print(\n                        f\"=== Mission {mission} COMPLETE in {dt_m:.1f}s | \"\n                        f\"est_pos=({agent.ekf.mu[0]:.1f},{agent.ekf.mu[1]:.1f}) dist_base={dist_base:.2f}m | \"\n                        f\"bat={agent.last_bat:.1f} | sampled={len(agent.sampled_ids)} | \"\n                        f\"eff={agent.eff_est:.4f} | bias={agent.ekf.mu[2]:.2f}deg | \"\n                        f\"slip={ {k: round(v,4) for k,v in agent.ekf.slip_dict().items()} } ===\",\n                        flush=True,\n                    )\n                    if out.get(\"campaign_complete\"):\n                        campaign_complete = True\n                    break\n\n                current_tick = int(out[\"current_tick\"])\n                arrived = out.get(\"packets\", [])\n                if arrived:\n                    # Log any interesting events\n                    for p in arrived:\n                        for ev in p.get(\"events\", []):\n                            print(f\"[M{mission} t={current_tick} pkt={p['tick']}] EVENT: {ev}\", flush=True)\n                    agent.ingest_packets(arrived, map_fetcher=tools.map)\n                    if agent.queue_cleared:\n                        print(f\"[M{mission} t={current_tick}] Queue cleared detected; syncing last_queued={current_tick}\", flush=True)\n                        last_queued = current_tick\n                        agent.queue_cleared = False\n\n                if current_tick % 25 == 0 or current_tick == max_ticks - 1:\n                    plan_head = agent.current_plan[:3]\n                    print(\n                        f\"[M{mission} t={current_tick:3d}] \"\n                        f\"est=({agent.ekf.mu[0]:5.1f},{agent.ekf.mu[1]:5.1f}) \"\n                        f\"bat={agent.last_bat:5.1f} sampled={len(agent.sampled_ids):2d} \"\n                        f\"eff={agent.eff_est:.3f} bias={agent.ekf.mu[2]:+5.2f} \"\n                        f\"plan={plan_head}\",\n                        flush=True,\n                    )\n\n        print(f\"\\nALL MISSIONS COMPLETE in {time.monotonic() - t_campaign:.1f}s!\", flush=True)\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    try:\n        run_campaign()\n    except Exception:\n        traceback.print_exc()\n        sys.exit(1)\n"},"output":"Wrote file {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794706617860,"sessionID":"ses_e2332780dffeAsz0uMEMGIoX2Z","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"lightlag_rules","callID":"o1TmX9ifJMPpsmi7","state":{"status":"completed","input":{},"output":"{\"version\":\"lightlag-traverse-v1\",\"delay_ticks\":3,\"max_ticks\":420,\"battery_capacity\":100.0,\"initial_battery\":100.0,\"idle_cost\":0.15,\"sample_cost\":2.0,\"target_radius\":2.5,\"base_radius\":4.0,\"solar_peak\":2.8,\"solar_efficiency_range\":[0.8,1.0],\"sun_margin_ticks\":56,\"supported_actions\":[\"drive\",\"sample\",\"wait\"],\"scripting_allowed\":true,\"first_execution_tick\":\"sent_tick + delay_ticks + 1; FIFO, one command per tick\",\"telemetry_arrival_tick\":\"state_tick + delay_ticks; tick 0 is the initial briefing\",\"max_commands_per_uplink\":5,\"max_metres_per_drive\":5.0,\"max_advance_ticks\":5,\"heading\":\"0 degrees east (+x), 90 north (+y); each executed drive travels at the commanded heading plus a heading error: a hidden bias, uniform in +-heading_bias_deg at launch, which takes a Gaussian random-walk step of heading_bias_walk_deg before every executed drive, plus independent Gaussian noise of heading_noise_deg; telemetry heading_deg reports the commanded heading\",\"ground\":\"map() gives elevation_cm[j][i], the height in centimetres at x = i * cell_m, y = j * cell_m, and terrain[j][i], the class code of the grid cell whose south-west corner is that vertex. Height between vertices is bilinear inside the cell. The slope at a point is the gradient of that bilinear surface: d/dx = ((h10 - h00) * (1 - ty) + (h11 - h01) * ty) / cell_m and d/dy = ((h01 - h00) * (1 - tx) + (h11 - h10) * tx) / cell_m, with tx, ty the point's fractions inside its cell and h10 the vertex to the east\",\"physics\":{\"segment_m\":0.25,\"max_tilt\":0.36,\"slip_base_ranges\":{\"bedrock\":[0.01,0.05],\"regolith\":[0.05,0.12],\"sand\":[0.15,0.35],\"rocks\":[0.12,0.24]},\"slip_grade_gain\":{\"bedrock\":0.8,\"regolith\":1.5,\"sand\":3.5,\"rocks\":1.2},\"slip_noise\":0.02,\"slip_max\":0.95,\"side_slip_gain\":{\"bedrock\":0.1,\"regolith\":0.3,\"sand\":0.8,\"rocks\":0.2},\"drive_cost_per_wheel_m\":{\"bedrock\":0.3,\"regolith\":0.36,\"sand\":0.5,\"rocks\":0.6},\"climb_cost_per_m\":2.0},\"drive\":\"a drive of M wheel metres is integrated in steps of segment_m, with the ground sampled where each step starts: grade = slope along the travelled heading, cross = slope to the left of it; slip = clip(slip_base[terrain] + slip_grade_gain[terrain] * max(0, grade) + noise, 0, slip_max), with slip_base[terrain] hidden inside slip_base_ranges and fixed for the mission, and noise one uniform draw in +-slip_noise per drive; the rover moves step * (1 - slip) along the heading and step * side_slip_gain[terrain] * cross to the right of it, which is downhill across the heading\",\"safety_stop\":\"a step that would leave the map, or end where the slope is steeper than max_tilt, is not taken: the rover stops at the last safe position and every queued command is cleared; their reserved ticks stay reserved\",\"energy\":\"each tick, in this order: the battery gains solar_peak * efficiency * sin(pi * (tick + sun_margin_ticks) / (max_ticks + 2 * sun_margin_ticks)), capped at battery_capacity, with efficiency hidden inside solar_efficiency_range and fixed for the mission; then idle_cost; then the command. A drive costs drive_cost_per_wheel_m[terrain] per wheel metre plus climb_cost_per_m per metre of height gained. A sample costs sample_cost, also when it fails. A battery that reaches 0 ends the rover for good\",\"sampling\":\"pay sample_cost; collect the nearest unsampled active target within target_radius; a discovered target is active from its appear tick\",\"sample_windows\":{\"late_fraction\":0.25,\"deadline\":\"deadline_tick per target in map(); null means no deadline\"},\"discoveries\":\"new targets appear mid-mission; a target_discovered event in the telemetry packet for its appear tick announces it, so it arrives delay_ticks later, and map() lists it from then on\",\"reward\":\"sum over sampled targets of value if the sample executed at or before deadline_tick, otherwise value * late_fraction; times 1 within base_radius of the lander, 0.5 alive elsewhere, 0 if the battery ran out; divided by the value of every target of the mission, discovered or not; scored at max_ticks\",\"sensing\":{\"position_noise_m\":1.0,\"visual_odometry_noise\":0.05,\"heading_bias_deg\":5.0,\"heading_bias_walk_deg\":0.2,\"heading_noise_deg\":1.5},\"telemetry\":\"one packet per tick: position = true position + Gaussian noise of position_noise_m per axis, clipped to the map (the tick-0 briefing is exact); battery and charge (the solar energy gained that tick) are exact; terrain is the class under the rover and tilt the slope there; wheel_odometry is the wheel metres of the drive and visual_odometry the ground distance moved * (1 + Gaussian noise of visual_odometry_noise)\",\"scoring_position\":\"sampling, the return to the lander and safety stops use the true position\",\"map_generator\":{\"width_m\":600.0,\"height_m\":400.0,\"cell_m\":5.0,\"relief_spacing_m\":[200.0,100.0,50.0,25.0,12.5],\"relief_amplitude_m\":[5.0,2.6,1.3,0.6,0.25],\"regional_tilt\":0.008,\"craters\":[3,5],\"crater_radius_m\":[22.0,60.0],\"crater_depth_ratio\":[0.19,0.24],\"crater_rim_ratio\":[0.03,0.05],\"crater_breaches\":[1,2],\"scarp_step_m\":[5.0,8.0],\"scarp_length_m\":[300.0,460.0],\"scarp_passes\":2,\"terrain_share\":{\"sand\":0.18,\"rocks\":0.12,\"bedrock\":0.15},\"sand_max_cell_slope\":0.1,\"initial_targets\":38,\"discoveries\":8,\"target_clusters\":5,\"cluster_targets\":[4,6],\"cluster_radius_m\":55.0,\"target_values\":[1,5],\"target_min_spacing_m\":15.0,\"target_min_base_distance_m\":35.0,\"deadline_share\":0.7,\"deadline_window\":[0.22,0.95],\"discovery_appear\":[30,0.68],\"discovery_window_ticks\":[60,130]},\"campaign\":{\"missions\":3,\"mission\":3,\"ticks_per_mission\":420,\"complete\":true,\"next_mission\":\"begins the moment the last tick of the mission in play passes: at its tick 0, on a new map, with the rover at that map's lander and a full battery. From then on rules, map, telemetry_log and uplink describe the new mission\",\"scoring\":\"each mission is scored as `reward` says; the campaign's score is the value credited in all missions divided by the value of every target of all of them\",\"after_the_last\":\"advance answers campaign_complete true and lets no time pass; uplink is refused\"}}","metadata":{"truncated":false},"title":"","time":{"start":1794706617849,"end":1794706617858}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dcd9b5f40011Y5aI9CB3EzeC1","sessionID":"ses_e2332780dffeAsz0uMEMGIoX2Z","messageID":"msg_1dcd9a58c00123GkxoxP9GkV00"}}

{"type":"text","timestamp":1794706623715,"sessionID":"ses_e2332780dffeAsz0uMEMGIoX2Z","part":{"id":"prt_1dcd9c64b001wX9fOrFubRx5N9","messageID":"msg_1dcd9b7e1001tTGPZviB5d6vor","sessionID":"ses_e2332780dffeAsz0uMEMGIoX2Z","type":"text","text":"The 3-mission Lightlag Traverse campaign is complete (`campaign.complete: true`), executed via `/app/autopilot.py` and `/app/rover_brain.py` (total wall time: 54.1s):\n\n- **Implementation**:\n  - `/app/rover_brain.py`: 7-state Extended Kalman Filter (`[x, y, bias_deg, slip_bedrock, slip_regolith, slip_sand, slip_rocks]`), terrain-aware safe 5 m Dijkstra router (`TerrainRouter`), deadline/solar-budget orienteering tour planner (`MissionPlanner`), and delay-aware closed-loop controller (`RoverMissionAgent`) with side-slip compensation and tilt perturbation checks.\n  - `/app/autopilot.py`: Campaign runner connecting to `http://lightlag:8000/mcp` and executing all 3 missions through `campaign_complete`.\n\n- **Campaign Results** (from `/app/autopilot.log`):\n  - **Mission 1** (base `[220.0, 120.0]`): 18 targets sampled, ended at estimated `(218.4, 120.3)` (`1.60 m` from lander), battery `27.2`, 0 safety stops.\n  - **Mission 2** (base `[325.0, 275.0]`): 24 targets sampled, ended at estimated `(323.9, 275.0)` (`1.13 m` from lander), battery `33.2`, 0 safety stops.\n  - **Mission 3** (base `[475.0, 220.0]`): 21 targets sampled, ended at estimated `(474.6, 220.8)` (`0.86 m` from lander), battery `10.9`, 0 safety stops.","time":{"start":1794706622027,"end":1794706623713}}}
